Changelog

What changed in each release of Divide for iPhone and iPad.

Your name from Apple, and account settings

October 3, 2026 · Build 17

New

  • Divide uses the name you share when you sign in with Apple, so there's no display name to set up. Change it anytime under You → Display name.
  • The privacy policy and support pages are linked from the You tab and the sign-in screen.

Improved

  • Deleting your account now asks you to confirm with your Apple ID, and disconnects Divide from it.

Fixed

  • Fixed account settings, including Delete account, being out of reach before you joined a group. They're now under Account on the start screen.

Recurring expenses are back

October 2, 2026 · Build 16

New

  • Recurring expenses return: set up rent, bills, and subscriptions once, and Divide adds each expense when it comes due.

Improved

  • Recurring expenses can use your group's own categories, and keep working if a category is later archived.

Easier reading on iPad

September 25, 2026 · Build 15

Improved

  • On a full-screen iPad, text is larger so the receipt layout is comfortable to read.
  • Insights stays on screen while a new month or range loads, instead of flashing a loading page.

Divide on iPad, and any past month in Insights

September 23, 2026 · Build 14

New

  • Divide now runs on iPad, in any orientation and in Split View, with keyboard shortcuts like ⌘N to add an expense.
  • Browse any past month in Insights, back to your group's first expense.
  • Sort a category's expenses by date or by amount.

Improved

  • Insights names the month you're looking at, like "Biggest in June", and months you've just viewed open instantly.

Faster entry and a deeper Insights

September 15, 2026 · Build 13

New

  • Add several expenses in a row: the Add sheet stays open after you save, keeps a running list of what you added, and lets you undo the last one.
  • Insights now covers the past 3, 6, or 12 months or all time, compares spending with earlier periods, and lets you tap a category to see its expenses.
  • The Tab points out expenses filed under Other, so you can move them to a better category.

Improved

  • Every expense shows its category icon, and the tab bar and add button have a cleaner look.

Your own categories

September 13, 2026 · Build 12

New

  • Rename the built-in categories, or add your own, from the You tab. Each group keeps its own list.

Improved

  • Adding or editing an expense offers your group's categories, including the ones you've made.

Backdate an expense

September 13, 2026 · Build 11

New

  • Change an expense's date when you add it, for something you paid for earlier.

Fixed

  • Fixed the date picker choosing a date while you were still scrolling through months.

Clearer balances and quicker splits

September 13, 2026 · Build 10

New

  • Split an expense in one tap: 50/50, or one person owes all of it.

Improved

  • Balances show a plus or minus sign as well as colour, and every expense shows what it means for you.
  • Expenses show who paid, and who added them when that's someone else.
  • Home shows the last eight expenses, and you can pull down to refresh.
  • Adding an expense explains what's missing instead of quietly not saving, and the keypad steps aside while you type a note.

Recurring expenses (preview)

July 24, 2026 · Build 9

New

  • Set up rent, subscriptions, and other repeating costs once, weekly, every two weeks, monthly, or yearly, and Divide adds each expense when it comes due.
  • When a recurring expense starts in the past, Divide shows how many expenses it will add and their total before adding them.

Account deletion and smoother sign-in

July 23, 2026 · Build 8

New

  • Delete your account from the You tab. Expenses you shared stay in your groups' records without your name.

Improved

  • If your session ends, Divide takes you back to sign-in and tells you why, instead of showing connection errors.
  • Divide stays in portrait on iPhone, where its layout is designed to be read.

Fixed

  • Fixed editing an expense in some languages and regions changing its amount, such as $12.34 becoming $1,234.00.

Add Expense from your Home Screen

July 20, 2026 · Build 7

New

  • Press and hold the Divide icon on your Home Screen and choose Add Expense to jump straight to a new expense.

A new look: the receipt tab

July 18, 2026 · Build 6

New

  • Divide has a new design that reads like a shared receipt, with Home, The Tab, Insights, and You tabs and a button in the middle for adding an expense.
  • Home opens on your main group and shows where you stand, this month's spending by category, and the latest expenses.
  • The Tab lists every expense by month, with the running balance at the bottom.
  • Insights shows the month's total, a breakdown by category, and how spending has changed over recent months.
  • Settle up records a payment between you in one step, and you can switch groups from a sheet on Home.

Improved

  • Better VoiceOver labels throughout the app.

Add an expense from anywhere

July 15, 2026 · Build 5

New

  • Add an expense straight from your group list. Divide picks the group you last added to, and you can switch groups in the form.

Balances in your group list

July 14, 2026 · Build 4

New

  • Each group in your list now shows your balance with that group, so you can see where you stand without opening it.

Improved

  • Activity is grouped by day, and each expense shows an icon for its category.
  • On a group's balances, your own row comes first and stands out from everyone else's.
  • Quick Add puts the cursor in the amount right away, shows the currency, and has a key to move on to the description.

Fixed

  • Fixed group balances going blank when you opened a group while the list was still refreshing.
